prompt: It is 7:45 pm. What time will it be in 40 minutes?

swarm-free-3c.text:
To find the time in 40 minutes, add 40 minutes to the current time. Since 40 minutes is equal to 2/3 of an hour, add 2/3 of an hour to 7:45 pm.

7:45 pm + 2 hours = 9:45 pm
9:45 pm + 15 minutes = 10:00 pm

So, it will be 10:00 pm.

swarm-fuse-3c.text:
To find the time in 40 minutes, add 40 minutes to the current time and consider both the hours and minutes parts.

7:45 pm + 40 minutes = 8:25 pm

So, it will be 8:25 pm.
